text:
sam: Heads up: Support flagged a p99 latency spike for customer 'mapleapps' after last runtime rollout (v12.3.0). p95 mostly fine, p99 up ~3-5x for short sequences. Threading here to triage.
support-bot: Alert: tenant=mapleapps p99 1.6s -> 6.2s after deploy at 4522222100. Links: https://grafana.internal/tenant/mapleapps/latency :warning:
alex: :eyes: Seen it. Is this only mapleapps or other tenants?
riley: Only maple and one other small tenant (sprout). Both are small-seq traffic, high cache hits previously.
cathy-oncall: I have the canary logs. I see an increase in KV cache miss rate for those tenants at ~4522222120. Also noticed kernel-selector switched to 'quant-opt-v2' on those nodes.
sam: Could be kernel change + warmup/placement. Any differences in batching config? Rollout included continuous-batching tweak (max_wait_ms lowered).
alex: I ran quick query in tracing: majority of p99 tails show extra 3-4ms in kernel compile fallback and a 200-400ms queueing event on hotpath queue.
riley: Queueing + kv misses matches: KV cache miss triggers longer compute path and smaller batches. If batching max_wait reduced, more small batches -> higher p99.
sam: Plan: 1) divert mapleapps traffic to previous runtime (v12.2.9) for mitigation, 2) bisect rollout to identify offending change, 3) collect perf traces and kernel selection logs for affected requests.
alex: I can flip routing for mapleapps. Command: `redwoodctl traffic set-route --tenant mapleapps --version v12.2.9` Doing it now.
deploy-bot: Action: traffic route change queued by alex. ETA 20s.
deploy-bot: Success: traffic route updated.
sam: Can someone run a focused p99 query before/after route change? `SELECT p50,p95,p99 FROM latency where tenant IN ('mapleapps') and model='shortseq-v1'`
cathy-oncall: Before: p99 6.2s. After routing: p99 dropped to 1.4s within 30s. :thumbsup: This confirms rollback mitigates.
riley: Next: bisect changes between v12.2.9..v12.3.0. Suspects: kernel-selector default, batching max_wait_ms change, and kv-cache eviction policy tweak.
alex: I started a git-bisect set up on runtime repo. Would appreciate someone to reproduce with a small local load harness (shortseq workload) to watch cache hit ratio and batch sizes.
sam: I'll run harness and attach logs. Repro steps: 1) generate 2000 shortseq requests/sec from one client, 2) only single-turn, seq len 8-12, 3) record batch sizes and kv_hits every 10s. Snippet: ```python
# example harness pseudo
for i in range(2000): post('/generate', data={'seq_len':10})
```
riley: Got the harness running. Early results: on v12.3.0 avg batch size = 2.1, kv_hit_rate 62%; on v12.2.9 avg batch size = 5.8, kv_hit_rate 92%.
sam: That's pretty decisive. Likely the batching change reduced aggregation window, causing smaller batches + cold cache churn. Short-term mitigation: revert batching tweak and pin kernel-selector to 'stable-v1' for rollout nodes.
alex: I'll open a rollback PR for the batching config and a hotpatch to pin kernel-selector. PR: #3892. Assigning to riley+sam for review.
riley: Reviewing now. Also recommend we add an automated smoke test that runs shortseq workload during canary to catch p99 regressions.
cathy-oncall: Agree. Also notify Support and affected customers: sent message to mapleapps support thread and offered to keep them on v12.2.9 until fix lands.
support-bot: Ticket #7654 updated: customer notified, routing reverted, monitoring set to 5m.
alex: Nice triage. Keeping thread open until PR merged and postrollout metrics stable for 1h.
